requiredFindings.title: The closed name grammar contradicts its malformed example
requiredFindings.finding: The pinned name expression admits pkg..x as a complete unscoped name, below the 214-character bound, with no subpath. The next sentence explicitly lists pkg..x as malformed. It is not a dot or dot-dot segment. An implementation following the name expression and segment rules will search its package candidates, while one following the example will refuse malformed. This leaves the core RF-1 goal of one normative disposition unresolved.
requiredFindings.requiredChange: Choose the intended disposition: remove/replace the pkg..x malformed example if dots within a name are allowed, or add the intended explicit name restriction to the normative grammar and controls. Make the pattern, segment rules and examples agree, including the scoped counterpart.
